# SnowPro Core Prep

> Free, open-source, self-hosted study app for the Snowflake SnowPro Core (COF-C03) certification.
> Turns a folder of plain markdown notes and questions into a real application: domain notes,
> scored practice quizzes, timed full-length mock exams, flashcards, an exam-date-adaptive study
> plan (with a crunch-mode compression path for a short runway), weighted readiness analytics, and
> multi-user accounts with admin management — all running locally via Docker, no cloud service, no
> telemetry, no account with a third party required.

This is an independent, unofficial personal project — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
sponsored by Snowflake Inc. "Snowflake" and "SnowPro" are trademarks of Snowflake Inc., referenced
only to describe which certification this tool helps study for. All notes and practice questions
are original and independently authored, verified against Snowflake's own public exam guide and
documentation.

Unlike the free/paid SnowPro Core practice-question sites elsewhere on the web (question banks
gated behind signup or ads, no self-hosting, no source available), this is a complete open-source
application you clone and run yourself: `git clone` + `docker compose up`, and it works out of the
box with a real, original bank of 500 distinct practice/mock questions across the exam's 5 weighted
domains. The content pipeline itself has no Snowflake-specific logic — swap the markdown for a
different exam's material and the same app works for that exam instead.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what the app does, features, how to run it (Docker / local dev / MCP
  server), how to add or edit content, multi-user setup, admin roles.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): architecture, file layout, data flow, and conventions — written for an
  AI coding agent working in this repo, but also the fastest way for a human to understand the
  whole system quickly.
- [TECH_STACK.md](TECH_STACK.md): what each technology in the stack is and why it's here, for
  someone learning the stack rather than this codebase's own structure.
- [DOCS_MAP.md](DOCS_MAP.md): which source files and which docs describe each feature area — the
  map this project's own doc-sync discipline is built on.

## Key subsystems

- [`app/`](app/): the React/TypeScript frontend — dashboard, notes reader, practice/mock quiz
  runner, flashcards, study plan, analytics, admin.
- [`pipeline/`](pipeline/): the markdown-to-content-JSON build pipeline plus the small
  Express/SQLite server that serves the built app and persists identity/progress.
- [`mcp-server/`](mcp-server/): a standalone MCP server exposing quiz sessions and progress
  tracking as tools, so an MCP host (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, a voice agent) can quiz someone
  conversationally instead of driving the web UI. See [mcp-server/README.md](mcp-server/README.md).
- [`SnowPro_Notes_and_Questions/`](SnowPro_Notes_and_Questions/): the actual study content — plain
  markdown, the format anyone can replace to retarget this app at a different exam.

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to open an issue or a PR against this repo.
